```{r DatabaseDownload}
# Connect to Local database server and pull all necessary data, then close connection 
con <- dbConnect(odbc(),
                    Driver = "SQL Server", 
                    Server = Server,
                    Database = Database,
                    Authentication = "ActiveDirectoryIntegrated")

hsdbShellPest <- tbl(con,in_schema("hsdb", "ShellPest")) %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(substring(SampleEventID, 1, 2) %in% Estuaries)

hsdbConditionIndex <- tbl(con,in_schema("hsdb", "ConditionIndex")) %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(substring(SampleEventID, 1, 2) %in% Estuaries)

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r DataFiltersBasic}
# Filter data frames so that only data collected for inclusion in the DMFM Report are present.
ShellPest <- hsdbShellPest %>% 
  mutate(Section = substring(OysterID, 3, 3),
         Year = as.integer(substring(SampleEventID, 8, 11)),
         Month = as.integer(substring(SampleEventID, 12, 13)),
         Season = case_when(
          Month >= 1 & Month <= 3 ~ "Winter",
          Month >= 4 & Month <= 6 ~ "Spring",
          Month >= 7 & Month <= 9 ~ "Summer",
          Month >= 10 & Month <= 12 ~ "Fall",
          TRUE ~ "Invalid")) %>%
  left_join(hsdbConditionIndex, by = c("OysterID")) %>%
  select(OysterID,
         PhotoSurface,
         TotalArea,
         ClionaArea,
         PolydoraArea,
         ClamCount,
         Section,
         Year,
         Month,
         Season,
         ShellHeight,
         TotalWeight) %>%
  filter(Year < 2023)

```
